## Accepted restricted result; original target unresolved

For problem 30001149 / OWR-3388-008, first substantive attempt (1/5), the exact-order-four weak-to-strong bridge is accepted after independent AI mathematical audit. Over algebraically closed characteristic two, the single-image degree-two Artin–Schreier hypothesis forces the entire orbit field to have degree two. The known conjugacy class then follows from the credited Bleher–Chinburg–Poonen–Symonds theorem.

The original all-primes/all-orders classification remains unresolved by this work: orders 2^n with n>=3 and odd-characteristic orders p^n with n>=2 remain outside the theorem. No original-problem counterexample or complete classification is claimed.

## Complete mathematics and review

The edition contains all four complete mathematical proofs and both full audits. It retains the characteristic-two initial-break restriction, all-primes interval/Galois/orbit-genus reductions, standalone r=3 exclusion, and r=2 elliptic/tame-quotient contradiction. The expanded quotient-length, ramification, Weierstrass and local Kummer arguments remain in the audits. The triple-field A_i in r=3 and pair-field A_i in r=2 stay distinct. No HKG or common-orbit-field hypothesis is silently imported.

Candidate/pending wording is explicitly updated to scoped acceptance; no mandatory mathematical repair was found. All material is AI-assisted and unrefereed. These audits are not external human peer review, formal proof-assistant certification, novelty certification or priority certification.

## Sources and publication boundary

The original question is credited to [Chinburg's OWR contribution](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2009/05); the known strong classification and single class to [BCPS](https://doi.org/10.1007/s00208-016-1490-2); the degree-equals-height lemma to [Byszewski–Cornelissen–Tijsma](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jalgebra.2022.03.019). All standard foundations and source-scope limits remain explicit.

Exactly eleven authored proof/audit/metadata files are added under unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30001149/. No QUEUE or historical-accounting change, source documents/extracts/images, datasets, scripts, computations, logs, private sources or private coordination material is included. Public source identities and retrieval/inspection history are retained; edition preparation makes no new source-retrieval, PDF-rehash or literature-search claim. No omitted computation is converted into prose.

Local strict clean-patch replay and native Git blob/tree identity checks passed. The complete expected tree chain preserves every unrelated entry. No remote verification or CI success is claimed by those local checks. Draft review publication only; no merge, release, DOI or outside outreach.
